reason: I'd take the free 15-company list, that costs me nothing but a call. But I paid an agency before on a nice guarantee and got slides, so I'm not paying EUR 1,600 this month to a small Sofia shop with one case study when Apollo and a junior SDR are sitting right there.
objection: One logistics client with 45 meetings is a story, not proof. And a refund at day 90 only works if you're still around and don't argue about what 'qualified' meant. I've seen that argument before.
would_change_my_mind: A call with two or three logistics or 3PL owners in CEE who actually ran the pilot, and the free list showing real shippers in my target country that I haven't already met at a trade fair.
